AKTA KERAJAAN TEMPATAN 1976

UNDANG-UNDANG KECIL PELESENAN PETEMPATAN MAKANAN
(WILAYAH PERSEKUTUAN LABUAN) 2016

PADA menjalankan kuasa  yang diberikan oleh perenggan 73(1)(c)
Akta Kerajaan Tempatan 1976 [Akta 171] (sebagaimana yang diperluas dan diubah suai
oleh Perintah Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan (Pemerluasan dan Ubah Suaian Akta
Kerajaan Tempatan 1976) 2010 [ P.U. (A) 4 39/2010]), Perbadanan Labuan membuat,
dan menurut seksyen 10 3 Akta,  Menteri meng esahkan, undang -undang kecil
yang berikut:

BAHAGIAN I
PERMULAAN

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Undang-undang kecil ini bolehlah dinamakan Undang-Undang Kecil
Pelesenan Petempatan Makanan (Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan) 2016.

(2) Undang-Undang Kecil ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2017.

Tafsiran
2. Dalam Undang-Undang Kecil ini, melainkan jika konteksnya menghendaki makna
yang lain—

"air limbah"  ertinya air hasil daripada kegunaan harian manusia daripada
mencuci, memasak, untuk mandi dan lain-lain kegunaan seumpamanya;

"alat perangkap minyak"  ertinya suatu alat yang digunakan sebagai penapis sisa
pepejal dan minyak di dalam sistem pelupusan air limbah;

 "fi lesen" ertinya kadar bayaran yang ditetapkan bagi sesuatu lesen yang
dikeluarkan di bawah  Undang-Undang Kecil ini sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
Jadual;

"ikan" ertinya binatang yang boleh di makan yang hidup di dalam air dan
termasuklah apa-apa hidupan air lain yang boleh dimakan oleh manusia;

"kad kategori"  ertinya kad kat egori yang dikel uarkan di bawah  undang-undang
kecil 27;

"makanan" termasuklah tiap -tiap barang yang dikilangkan, dijual atau
digambarkan untuk digunakan sebagai makanan atau minuman bagi kegunaan manusia
atau yang diguna di dalam ko mposisi, penyediaan  dan pengawetan mana-mana
makanan atau minuman bagi kegunaan manusia dan termasuklah konfeksi, bahan
kunyahan dan apa -apa bahan bagi makanan, minuman, ko nfeksi atau bahan kunyahan
itu;

"pemegang lesen" ertinya mana -mana orang yang kepadanya lesen petempatan
makanan dikeluarkan di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil ini;

"penyediaan maka nan" atau "menyediakan makanan"  termasuklah
mengendalikan, menghidang atau menjual makanan;

"Perbadanan" ertinya Perbadanan Labuan yang ditubuhkan di bawah seksyen 3
Akta Perbadanan Labuan 2001 [Akta 609];

"petempatan makanan" ertinya bangunan atau mana -mana bahagian bangunan
di mana makanan untuk dimakan oleh manusia diproses, disedia, dis impan, dihidang,
atau dijual bagi maksud perniagaan.

BAHAGIAN II
PELESENAN

Lesen diperlukan bagi petempatan makanan
3. (1) Mana-mana orang boleh  menggunakan sesuatu bangunan  atau
mana-mana bahagian bangunan sebagai petempatan makanan apabila suatu kebenaran
perancangan, jika perlu , bagi maksud tersebut telah diperolehi di bawah

undang-undang perancangan yang berkaitan dan suatu lesen petempatan makanan
dikeluarkan berkaitan dengan bangunan itu atau mana -mana bahagian bangunan itu
oleh Perbadanan di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil ini.

(2) Mana-mana orang yang melanggar perenggan  (1) melakukan suatu
kesalahan.

Permohonan bagi lesen
4. (1) Tertakluk kepada undang-undang kecil 3, sesuatu permohonan bagi suatu
lesen di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini hendaklah dibuat dalam apa -apa bentuk dan
cara sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

(2) Perbadanan boleh meluluskan atau tidak meluluskan sesuatu
permohonan bagi suatu lesen di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil ini.

(3) Perbadanan boleh, jika difikirkan nya perlu, menghendaki mana -mana
pemohon untuk hadir sendiri dan bagi pihak sesuatu pe rbadanan atau firma  atau
seorang wakil yang diberi kuasa oleh perbadanan atau firma tersebut untuk hadir  bagi
memberi apa -apa dokumen atau maklumat  lanjut berkaitan dengan sesuatu
permohonan bagi suatu lesen.

(4) Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah Und ang-Undang Kec il ini adalah
tertakluk kepada—

(a) tempoh lesen sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan;

(b) kesesuaian dan saiz bangunan yang akan digunakan untuk
mengendalikan petempatan makanan yang dicadangkan;

(c) peruntukan Undang -Undang Kecil  ini, syarat dan sekatan yang
dikenakan oleh Perbadanan dan oleh mana -mana pihak berkuasa
yang berkenaan;

(d) bayaran deposit  sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam
undang-undang kecil 8;

(e) bayaran fi lesen sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual;

(f) jika Perbadanan fikirkan  perlu, mene ntukan bilangan unit meja
dan kerusi untuk digunakan  di petempatan makanan yang
dicadangkan; dan

(g) apa-apa kehendak yang lain di bawah mana -mana undang-undang
yang berkaitan.

(5)      Perbadanan boleh, dari semasa ke semasa dan semasa sesuatu lesen masih
berkuat kuasa, mengenakan apa -apa syarat tambahan ke atas lesen itu atau mengubah
atau membatalkan apa-apa syarat yang dikenakan ke atas lesen itu.

(6)  Suatu notis bertulis hendaklah diberikan kepada pemegang lesen sebelum
Perbadanan membuat apa-apa keputusan di bawah perenggan (5).

Ketidaklayakan
5. Walau apa pun  undang-undang kecil 4 , tiada lesen boleh dikeluarkan di bawah
Undang-Undang Kecil ini kepada mana-mana orang yang—

(a) berumur di bawah lapan belas tahun; atau

(b) jika bangunan yang dicadangkan  olehnya, pada pendapat Perbadanan,
tidak ses uai untuk digunakan sebagai petempatan makanan atau
bangunan yang dicadangkan  terletak dalam kawasan yang tidak sesuai
untuk mengendalikan petempatan makanan yang dicadangkan.

Bentuk lesen
6. Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini hendaklah
dalam apa-apa bentuk sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

Fi lesen
7. (1) Fi lesen yang k ena dibayar bagi pengeluaran s uatu lesen di bawah
Undang-Undang Kecil ini adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Perbadanan boleh mengecualikan mana -mana pemegang lesen daripada
tanggungan untuk membayar kesemua atau mana-mana bahagian daripada fi lesen.

(3) Fi lesen yang dibayar di bawah perenggan (1) tidak boleh dibayar balik.

Deposit
8. (1) Perbadanan boleh menghendaki mana-mana orang yang kepadanya lesen
telah di keluarkan untuk membayar deposit sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lima
puluh ribu ringgit  untuk memastikan bahawa  peruntukan Akta, Undang -Undang Kecil,
syarat atau sekatan lesen dipatuhi.

(2) Walau apa  pun perenggan (1), Perbadanan boleh mengecualikan
mana-mana pemegang lesen daripada tanggungan untuk membayar keseluruhan atau
sebahagian deposit.

(3) Sekiranya ter dapat pelanggaran mana -mana perunt ukan Akta,
Undang-Undang Kecil, syarat atau sekatan lesen, Perbadanan hendaklah memberi notis
kepada pemegang lesen  dalam tempoh yang ditetapkan dalam notis untuk memberi
representasi kenapa depositnya tidak boleh dilucuthakkan.

(4) Perbadanan boleh, setelah mempertimbangkan representasi yang
dikemukakan oleh pemegang lesen  atau jika pe megang lesen gagal membuat
representasi, memutuskan sama ada untuk melucuthak kan keseluruhan atau
sebahagian deposit.

(5) Tertakluk kepada perenggan (4), Perbadanan boleh menghendaki
pemegang lesen untuk menggantikan kese luruhan atau sebahagian  deposit yang telah
dilucuthakkan.

(6) Deposit yang dibayar hendaklah, melainkan jika dilucuthakkan, dibayar
balik kepada pemegang lesen tanpa apa -apa pelarasan bagi faedah atas amaun yang
diberikan di bawah perenggan (1) selepas pemegang lesen berhenti mengendalikan
petempatan makanan itu.

(7) Seseorang pemegang lesen hendaklah memaklumkan kepada Perbadanan
jika dia telah berhenti mengendalikan petempatan makanan itu.

(8) Bagi maksud perenggan (7), pemegang lesen hendaklah memohon kepada
Perbadanan dalam tempoh tiga puluh hari dari tarikh dia berhenti mengendalikan
petempatan makanan itu untuk depositnya dibayar balik.

(9) Sekiranya pemegang lesen tidak memohon untuk deposit nya dibayar
balik atau depositnya tidak dituntut dalam tempoh yang dinyatakan di  bawah
perenggan (8) , deposit itu hendaklah dilucuthakkan dan hendaklah dibayar ke dalam
Kumpulan Wang Perbadanan Labuan dan hendaklah menjadi sebahagian daripada hasil
kumpulan wang itu.

Lesen gantian
9. Jika Perbadanan berpuas hati bahawa suatu lesen yang sah yang dikeluarkan
di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini hilang, cacat atau rosak, Perbadanan boleh
mengeluarkan lesen gantian.

Pindah milik lesen
10. (1) Pemegang lesen boleh mengemukakan permohonan untuk memindah
milik lesen kepada man a-mana pihak dengan apa -apa bentuk  sebagaimana yang
ditentukan oleh Perbadanan dan Perbadanan boleh meluluskan atau menolak
permohonan tersebut.

(2) Fi pindah milik lesen adalah sebanyak dua puluh lima ringgit.

(3) Walau apa pun perenggan ( 1), sekiranya berlaku pertukaran entiti atau
perubahan nama dalam entiti, pemegang lesen hendaklah mengemukakan salinan sijil
pengesahan pertukaran daripada Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia.

Pembaharuan lesen
11. (1) Suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini tidak
boleh diperbaharui sebagai suatu hak dan sesuatu permohonan untuk memperbaharui
suatu lesen hendaklah dianggap sebagai permohonan untuk suatu lesen.

(2) Sesuatu permohonan untuk memperbaharui suatu  lesen hendaklah
dibuat dalam tempoh masa enam puluh hari sebelum tarikh tamat lesen itu dan
hendaklah dibuat dalam apa -apa bentuk dan cara sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh
Perbadanan.

(3) Perbadanan boleh, jika difi kirkannya perlu, menghendaki mana-mana
pemohon untuk hadir sendiri atau bagi pihak sesuatu perbadanan atau firma  atau
seorang wakil yang diberi kuasa oleh perbadanan atau firma tersebut untuk hadir bagi
memberi apa -apa dokumen ata u maklumat lanjut berkaitan dengan sesuatu
permohonan untuk memperbaharui suatu lesen.

(4) Perbadanan boleh memperbaharui atau tidak memperbaharui suatu lesen
dan hendaklah memaklumkan pemohon keputusannya itu secara bertulis atau melalui
apa-apa cara yang lain sebagaimana yang akan ditentukan oleh Perbadanan dan
membayar balik deposit kepada pemohon tertakluk kepada perenggan 8(9).

(5) Suatu lesen jika diperbaharui di bawah perenggan (4) adalah tertakluk
kepada—

(a) tempoh lesen sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan;

(b) bayaran fi lesen sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual; dan

(c) peruntukan Undang -Undang Kecil ini, syarat -syarat dan
sekatan-sekatan yang dikenakan oleh Perbadanan dan oleh
mana-mana pihak berkuasa yang berkenaan.

(6) Tiada deposit lanjut perlu diberi  oleh pem egang lesen jika lesennya
diperbaharui.

(7) Jika difikirkan perlu oleh Perbadanan, suatu lesen untuk kedai makan dan
restoran adalah tertakluk kepada undang-undang kecil 1 3 sebelum diperbaha rui
di bawah undang-undang kecil ini.

(8) Perbadanan tidak akan bertanggungjawab untuk membayar apa -apa
pampasan kepada pemegang lesen sekiranya lesen tidak di perbaharui di bawah
perenggan (4).

Pembatalan lesen
12. (1) Perbadanan boleh me mbatalkan suatu lesen yang dikeluarkan di bawah
undang-undang kecil 4 jika ia berpuas hati bahawa—

(a) pemegang lesen itu telah melanggar mana-mana peruntukan Akta,
Undang-Undang Kecil, syarat atau sekatan lesen;

(b) pemegang lesen itu telah , sama ada be rhubung dengan sesuatu
permohonan untuk suatu lesen atau pada bila -bila masa selepas
suatu lesen dikeluarkan, mengemukakan kepada Perbadanan
suatu dokumen atau perisytiharan yang palsu, mengelirukan atau
tidak tepat;

(c) pemegang lesen itu tidak mengendalikan petempatan makanan
yang dilesenkan selama tempoh tiga bulan berturut -turut tanpa
memaklumkan kepada Perbadanan; atau

(d)  suatu perintah penggulungan atau perintah kebankrapan telah
dibuat terhadap pemegang lesen atau sua tu ketetapan bagi
penggulungan sukarela telah diluluskan.

(2) Pembatalan lesen di bawah perenggan (1) boleh dibuat oleh
Perbadanan tanpa apa -apa bayaran pampasan kepada pemegang lesen dan
Perbadanan boleh melucuthakkan keseluruhan deposit yang telah dibayar di bawah
undang-undang kecil 8.

(3) Sebelum suatu lesen dibatalkan , Perbadanan hendaklah memberi notis
secara bertulis kepada pemegang lesen menghendakinya membuat representasi dalam
tempoh sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam notis kenapa lesennya tidak boleh
dibatalkan.

(4) Selepas tamat tempoh masa yang dinyatakan dalam notis di bawah
perenggan (3) d an setelah men imbangkan representasi pemegang lesen atau jika
pemegang lesen gagal membuat representasi, Perbadanan hendaklah terus
mempertimbangkan perkara tersebut dan memaklumkan keputusannya dalam notis
bertulis kepada pemegang lesen.

(5) Jika Perbadanan memutuskan untuk membatalkan lesen itu, pembatalan
lesen itu hendaklah mula berkuat kuasa pada tarikh yang dinyatakan dalam notis yang
diserahkan kepada pemegang lesen.

(6) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang mengendalikan petempatan makanan
setelah lesennya dibatalkan di bawah perenggan (5) melakukan suatu kesalahan.

BAHAGIAN III
KEHENDAK KHAS BAGI KEDAI MAKAN DAN RESTORAN

Kehendak bagi kedai makan dan restoran
13. (1) Jika suatu permohonan untuk lesen petempatan makanan bagi kedai
makan dan restoran  diluluskan, tetapi sebelum lesen bagi maksud itu dikeluarkan

di bawah undang -undang kecil 4  atau sebelum lesen itu diperbaharui di ba wah
undang-undang kecil 11, pemohon hendaklah , jika difikirkan perlu oleh Perbadanan,
mematuhi kehendak yang berikut:

(a) mendapatkan sijil halal sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan
di bawah undang-undang kecil 14;

(b) memasang alat perangkap  minyak mengikut spesifikasi yang
ditentukan oleh Perbadanan sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan
di bawah undang-undang kecil 15; dan

(c) memasang kemudahan internet dalam kedai makan dan restoran
tersebut sebagaim ana yang diperuntukkan di bawah
undang-undang kecil 16.

(2) Jika pemohon gagal melaksanakan kehendak di bawah perenggan ( 1),
lesen di bawah undang-undang kecil 4 tidak boleh  dikeluarkan atau lesen itu tidak
boleh diperbaharui di bawah undang-undang kecil 11.

(3) Perbadanan tidak akan  bertanggungjawab untuk membayar apa -apa
pampasan kepada pemohon jika lesen tidak dikeluarkan di bawah
undang-undang kecil 4 atau lesen tidak diperbaharui di bawah undang-undang kecil 11
akibat kegagalan pemohon untuk mematuhi kehendak di bawah perenggan (1).

Keperluan mendapatkan sijil halal
14. Mana-mana kedai makan dan restoran  yang menyediakan makanan yang boleh
dimakan oleh orang Islam, hendaklah mendapatkan sijil pengesahan hala l daripada
Jabatan Kemajuan Islam Malaysia (JAKIM) atau mana -mana pihak berkuasa yang
berkenaan dan tertakluk kepada undang-undang yang berkaitan dengannya.

Alat perangkap minyak
15. (1) Mana-mana kedai makan dan res toran hendaklah menyediakan dan
memasang alat perangkap minyak mengikut spesifikasi yang ditentukan oleh

Perbadanan dan memastikan air limbah dari pada setiap sinki di kedai makan atau
restoran itu disalurkan melalui alat perangkap minyak tersebut.

(2) Air buangan dari pada alat perangkap miny ak itu hendaklah disalurkan
ke salu ran yang mempunyai sambungan terus ke sistem pembe tungan, tangki septik
atau sistem rawatan pembetungan yang lain.

(3) Semua sisa pepejal dan minyak yang terperangkap dalam alat perangkap
minyak hendaklah dilupuskan mengikut cara yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

(4) Pemegang lesen hendaklah menyenggara atau menyebabkan dise nggara
alat perangkap minyak mengikut cara yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

(5) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang tidak mematuhi  undang-undang kecil
ini melakukan suatu kesalahan.

Kemudahan internet
16. (1) Mana-mana kedai makan dan restoran  yang Perbadanan fikirkan sesuai ,
hendaklah menyediakan kemudahan internet tertakluk kepada syarat dan sekatan
sebagaimana yang ditentukan oleh Perbadanan.

(2) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang tidak mematuhi  perenggan (1)
melakukan suatu kesalahan.

Hiburan di kedai makan dan restoran
17. Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang dilesenkan di bawah Undang -Undang Kecil ini
yang menyediakan hiburan di kedai makan dan restoran  hendaklah memohon  suatu
lesen hiburan di bawah undang-undang yang berkaitan dengannya.

Larangan perniagaan lain dalam kedai makan dan restoran
18. (1) Walau apa pun undang-undang kecil 17 , t iada aktiviti perniagaan lain
boleh dibenarkan dalam mana-mana kedai makan atau restoran.

(2) Mana-mana pemegang lesen  yang melanggar perenggan (1) melakukan
suatu kesalahan.

Larangan menjalankan perniagaan di luar kedai makan dan restoran
19. (1) Seseorang pemegang lesen tidak dibenarkan untuk menjalankan aktiviti
perniagaannya di luar  kedai makan da n restoran  yang telah dilesenkan melainkan
dengan kelulusan Perbadanan.

(2) Pemegang lesen boleh memohon  kelulusan Perbadanan untuk
menjalankan aktiviti pe rniagaannya di luar  kedai makan dan restoran yang telah
dilesenkan.

(3) Perbadanan boleh meluluskan atau tidak meluluskan suatu permohonan
di bawah perenggan (1).

(4) Kelulusan yang diberikan oleh Perbadanan di bawah perenggan (3)
hendaklah tertakluk kepada apa -apa pembayaran fi sebagaimana yang ditetapkan oleh
Perbadanan dan syarat atau sekatan yang dikenakan oleh Perbadanan.

(5) Mana-mana pemegang lesen  yang melanggar perenggan (1) melakukan
suatu kesalahan.

Penyediaan makanan
20. (1) Dalam mana -mana kedai makan dan restoran di mana kedua-dua
makanan yang halal dan makanan yang tidak halal disediakan dan dihidangkan,
pemegang lesen hendaklah—

(a) membasuh dan men yimpan apa-apa makanan dan perkakas yang
digunakan untuk menyediakan makanan yang  halal dan makanan
yang tidak halal di tempat yang berasingan; dan

(b) menggunakan apa -apa perkakas yang berasingan bagi
menyediakan makanan yang halal dan makanan yang tidak halal.

(2) Pemegang lesen hendaklah memastikan bahawa apa -apa perkakas yang
digunakan untuk menyediakan makanan yang tidak halal diambil dari pada dan
digunakan hanya di tempat di mana makanan yang tidak halal disediakan.

(3) Sekiranya makanan yang tidak halal disediakan di kedai makan dan
restoran, pemegang lesen hendaklah pada setiap masa mempamerkan notis  yang
menyatakan "Makanan Yang Tidak Halal Sahaja" pada mana-mana bahagian kedai
makan dan restoran tersebut yang mudah dilihat.

(4) Bagi maksud  undang-undang kecil ini , "makanan yang halal" hendaklah
mempunyai erti sebagaimana yang ditakrif kan dalam Perintah Perihal Dagangan
(Takrif Halal) 2011 [P.U. (A) 430/2011].

(5) Mana-mana pemegang lesen yang melanggar undang -undang kecil ini
melakukan suatu kesalahan.

preservation of any food or drink for human consum ption and includes confectionary,
chewing substances and any ingredient of such food, drink, confectionary or chewing
substances;

"licensee" means any person to whom a food establishment  licence is issued
under these By-laws;

"food preparation" or "preparing food" includes handling, serving or selling food;

"Perbadanan" means the Perbadanan Labuan established under section 3 of the
Perbadanan Labuan Act 2001 [Act 609];

"food establishment" means a building or any part of a building where food for
human consumption is processed, prepared, stored, served or s old for the purpose of
business.

PART II
LICENSING

Licence required for food establishment
3. (1) Any person  may us e a building or any part of a building as a food
establishment when a planning  approval, if necessary, for that purpose has been
obtained under the relevant planning law and a food establishment  licence has been
issued pertaining to  the building or any pa rt of the building  by the Perbadanan under
these By-laws.

(2) Any person who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Application for a licence
4. (1) Subject to by-law 3, an application for a licence under these By -laws shall
be made in such form and manner as determined by the Perbadanan.

(2) The Perbadanan may approve or not approve an application for a licence
under these By-laws.

(3) The Perbadanan may , if it thinks necessary, require any applicant to
attend in person and on behalf of a corporation or firm  or a representative authorised
by the corporation or firm to atten d to furnish any  document or further information
regarding an application for a licence.

(4) A licence issued under these By-laws shall be subject to—

(a) the licence period as determined by the Perbadanan;

(b) the suitability and the size of the building to be used to operate the
proposed food establishment;

(c) the provisions of these By -laws, conditions and restrictions
imposed by the Perbadanan and by any relevant authorities;

(d) payment of deposit as provided in by-law 8;

(e) payment of a licence fee as prescribed in the Schedule;

(f) if the Perbadanan  thinks necessary, the determination of  the
number of tables and chairs to be used in the proposed food
establishment; and

(g) any other requirements under any relevant laws.

(5) The Perbadanan may, f rom time to time and while a licence is still in
force, impose any additional conditions on the licence or amend or revoke any condition
imposed on the licence.

(6)  A written notice shall be given to the licensee before the Perbadanan
makes any decision under paragraph (5).

Disqualification
5. Notwithstanding by-law 4, no licence shall be issued under these By-laws to any
person—

(a) under the age of eighteen years old; or

(b) if the building proposed by him, in the opinion of the Perbadanan,
is not su itable to be used as a food establishment or the proposed
building is located in an area which is not suitable for operating
the proposed food establishment.

Form of licence
6. A licence issued under these By -laws shall be in any form as may be determined
by the Perbadanan.

Licence fee
7. (1) The licence fee payable for the issuance of a licence under these By -laws
is as prescribed in the Schedule.

(2) The Perbadanan may exempt any licensee from the responsibility of
paying the whole or any part of the licence fee.

(3) The licence fee paid under paragraph (1) shall not be refundable.

Deposit
8. (1) The Perbadanan may require any person to whom a licence is issued to
pay a deposit of an amount of money not exceeding fifty thousand ringgit to ensure tha t
the provisions of the Act, By-laws, conditions or restrictions of the licence are observed.

(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the Perbadanan may exempt any licensee
from the liability of paying the whole or any part of the deposit.

(3) If there is a b reach of any of the provision s of the Act, By-laws, conditions
or restrictions of the licence, the Perbadanan shall give a notice to the licensee within
the time specified in the notice to give representation as to why his deposit shall not be
forfeited.

(4) The Perbadanan may, after considering the representation given by the
licensee or if the licensee fails to make a representation, decide s either to forfeit the
whole or part of the deposit.

(5) Subject to paragraph (4), the Perbadanan may require th e licensee to
replenish the whole or part of the deposit that has been forfeited.

(6) The deposit paid shall, unless forfeited, be refunded to the licensee
without any adjustment for interest on the amount deposited under paragraph (1) after
the licensee has ceased operating the food establishment.

(7) A licensee shall inform the Perbadanan if he has ceased operating a food
establishment.

(8) For the purpose of paragraph (7), the licensee shall apply to the
Perbadanan within thirty days from the date he has ceased operating the food
establishment for his deposit to be refunded.

(9) If the licensee does not apply for his deposit to be refunded or the deposit
is not claimed within the period specified under paragraph (8), the deposit shall be

forfeited and shall be paid into the Perbadanan Labuan Fund  and shall form part of the
revenue of the fund.

Replacement licence
9. If the Perbadanan is satisfied that a  valid licence issued under these By -laws is
lost, defaced or damaged, the Perbadanan may issue a replacement licence.

Transfer of licence
10. (1) A licensee may submit an application to transfer the licence to any part y
in such form as determined by the Perbadanan and the Perbadanan may approve or
refuse such application.

(2) The fee for the transfer of the licence shall be twenty five ringgit.

(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), if there is a change of entity or change of
name in the entity, the licensee shall forward a copy of the certification of the change
from the Companies Commission of Malaysia.

Renewal of licence
11. (1) A licence issued under these By -laws shall not be renewed as a right and
an application for renewal of a licence shall be deemed as an application for a licence.

(2) An application for renewal of a licence shall be made within  sixty days
before the expiry of the licence and shall be made in such form and manner as may be
determined by the Perbadanan.

(3) The Perbadanan m ay, if it thinks necessary, require any applicant to
attend in person or on behalf of a corporation or firm  or a representative authorised by
the corporation or firm to attend to furnish any document or further information
regarding an application to renew a licence.

(4) The Perbadanan may renew or not renew a licence and shall inform the
applicant of its decision in writing or by any other manner as may be determined by the
Perbadanan and to refund the deposit to the applicant subject to paragraph 8(9).

(5) A licence if renewed under paragraph (4) shall be subject to—

(a) the licence period as determined by the Perbadanan;

(b) payment of a licence fee as prescribed in the Schedule; and

(c) the provisions of these By -laws, conditions and restrictions
imposed by the Perbadanan and by any relevant authorities.

(6) No further deposit need to be given by the licens ee if his licence is
renewed.

(7) If the Perbadanan thinks necessary , a licence for an eating-house and
restaurant is subject to by-law 13 before it is renewed under this by-law.

(8) The Perbadanan shall not be responsible to pay any compensation to the
licensee if the licence is not renewed under paragraph (4).

Revocation of licence
12. (1) The Perbadanan may revoke a licence issued under by-law 4 if it is
satisfied that—

(a) the licensee has contravened any provision s of the  Act, By -laws,
conditions or restrictions of the licence;

(b) the licensee, e ither in relation  to the application of a licence or at
any time after a licence is issued, has submitted to the Perbadanan
a document or declaration which is false, confusing or not
accurate;

(c) the licensee has not operated the licensed food establishment for a
consecutive period of three months without info rming the
Perbadanan; or

(d)  a winding up order or bankruptcy order was made against the
licensee or a resolution for volunta ry winding up has been
approved.

(2) The r evocation of a licence under paragraph (1) may be made by the
Perbadanan without any payment of compensation to the licensee and the Perbadanan
may forfeit the whole deposit paid under by-law 8.

(3) Before a licence  is revoked, the Perbadanan shall give a notice in writing
to the licensee requiring him to make a representation within the period as specified in
the notice as to why his licence shall not be revoked.

(4) After the expiry of the period specified in the notice under paragraph (3)
and after considering the licensee's representation or if the licensee fails to make a
representation, the Perbadanan shall proceed to consider such matter and inform his
decision in a written notice to the licensee.

(5) If the Perbadanan decides to revoke the licence, the revocation of the
licence shall take effect on the date specified in the notice served to the licensee.

(6) Any licensee who  operates a food establishment after his licence is
revoked under paragraph (5) commits an offence.

PART III
SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR EATING-HOUSES AND RESTAURANTS

Requirements for eating-houses and restaurants
13. (1) If an application for a food establishment licence for an eating-house and
restaurant is approved, but before such licence for that purpose  is issued under

by-law 4 or before the licence is renewed under by-law 11, the applicant shall, if the
Perbadanan thinks necessary, comply with the following requirements:

(a) obtain a halal certificate as provided under by-law 14;

(b) install a grease trap equipment according to the specification
determined by the Perbadanan as provided under by-law 15; and

(c) install internet facilities in the eating-house and restaurant as
provided under by-law 16.

(2) If the applicant fails to comply wit h the requirements under
paragraph (1), a licence under by-law 4 shall not be issued or the licen ce shall not be
renewed under by-law 11.

(3) The Perbadanan shall not be responsible to pay for any compensation to
the applicant if the li cence not issued under by-law 4 or  the licence is not renewed
under by-law 11 due to the failure of the applicant to comply with re quirements under
paragraph (1).

Requirement to obtain halal certificate
14. Any eating-house and restaurant which prepar es food which is consumable by
Muslims, shall obtain a halal certificate from the Malaysia n Department of Islamic
Development (JAKIM) or from any other relevant authority and shall be subjec t to the
laws relevant to it.

Grease trap equipment
15. (1) Any eating-house and restaurant shall provide and install a grease trap
equipment in accordance with the specification s determined by the Perbadanan and
ensure the sullage water from every sink in the eating-house or restaurant is channelled
through the grease trap equipment.

(2) Waste water from the grease trap equipment shall be channelled through
a tunnel which has a direct connection into the sewerage system, septic tank or into any
sewerage treatment system.

(3) All trapped solid waste and oil in the grease t rap equipment shall be
disposed of in the manner determined by the Perbadanan.

(4) The licensee shall maintain or cause to be maintain ed the grease trap
equipment in the manner determined by the Perbadanan.

(5) Any licensee who fails to comply with this by-law commits an offence.

Internet facilities
16. (1) Any eating-house and restaurant which the Perbadanan thinks suitable,
shall provide internet facilities subject to the conditions and restrictions as may be
determined by the Perbadanan.

(2) Any licensee who fails to comply with paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Entertainment in eating-houses and restaurants
17. Any licensee licensed under these By -laws who provides entertainment in an
eating-house and restaurant shall apply for an entertainment lice nce under the law s
relevant to it.

Prohibition of other businesses in eating-houses and restaurants
18. (1) Notwithstanding by-law 17, no other business activities can be allowed in
any eating-house or restaurant.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Prohibition of operating business outside eating-houses and restaurants
19. (1) A licensee is not allowed to operate his business activity  outside his
licensed eating-house and restaurant unless with the approval of the Perbadanan.

(2) The licensee may apply  for the Perbadanan's approval to  operate his
business activity outside the licensed eating-house and restaurant.

(3) The Perbadanan may approve or not approve  an application under
paragraph (1).

(4) An appr oval given by the Perbadanan under paragraph (3) shall be
subject to any payment of fee s as may be determine d by the Perbadanan and the
conditions or restrictions imposed by the Perbadanan.

(5) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Preparation of food
20. (1) In any eating -house and restaurant where both halal food and non-halal
food are prepared and served, the licensee shall—

(a) wash and store any  food and utensil s used to prepare  halal food
and non-halal food in separate places; and

(b) use separate set s of utensil s for preparing suc h halal food and
non-halal food.

(2) The licensee shall ensure that any utensil used to pr epare such non -halal
food is taken from and used only in the place where non-halal food is prepared.

(3) Where non-halal food is prepared in the eating-house and restaurant, the
licensee shall at all times display a notice stating "Non-Halal Food Only" at any
conspicuous part in that eating-house and restaurant.

(4) For the purpose  of this by -law, "halal food" shall have the same meaning
as defined in the Trade Descriptions (Definition of Halal) Order  2011
[P.U. (A) 430/2011].

(5) Any licensee who contravenes this by-law commits an offence.

Other requirements
21. (1) Every eating-house and restaurant licensee shall comply with the
following requirements:

(a) the eating area s for customers and the place s where the food is
served shall not be used for any other purpose other than as eating
areas or as places to serve food;

(b) the tables and counter s used for processing and preparing food
shall be made from suitable and easily cleaned materials or as
approved by the Perbadanan;

(c) the floor s and the walls of the eating areas or the place s where
food is serve d shall be made from  suitable and easily cleaned
materials or as approved by the Perbadanan;

(d) sink are to be provided according to the number determined by
the Perbadanan for the use of customers and the sinks shall be
maintained in a clean and good condition at all times;

(e) toilets are to be provided according to the number determined by
the Perbadanan and the toilets shall be maintain ed in a clean and
good condition at all times;

(f) the toilet wall s shall be installed with suitable and easily cleaned
materials or as approved by the Perbadanan;

(g) every toilet shall be equipped with a water tap or a rubber pipe for
cleaning purposes;

(h) every toilet at all times shall be equipped with toilet paper,
detergent, fragrance or air fragrance, dustbin, electric hand drye r,
rolled towel, clean towel or tissue paper;

(i) the toilet floor is clean and dry at all times;

(j) every toilet shall have sufficient lighting and ventilation;

(k) the toilet is open for public use during business hours;

(l) the size of the kitche n shall be built in accordance with  the
specifications as determined by the Perbadanan and the walls shall
be made from suitable and easily cleaned materials or as approved
by the Perbadanan;

(m) materials used for the prepara tion of food, utensils, cutlery  or
containers used shall not be placed or washed on t he floor except
in the area which is reserved for washing which is
at least 0.45 metre high from the floor level in the kitchen area;
and

(n) no cooked food for sale can be placed on the floor in any part of the
eating-house and restaurant.

(2) Any licensee who fails to comply with paragraph (1) commits an offence.

PART IV
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Prohibitions
22. (1) No licensee shall—

(a) employ any person who is under the age of eighteen years old;

(b) employ any foreigner without a valid work permit to work in his
food establishment;

(c) allow any gam bling or immoral activity  or allow any conduct
which will cause nuisance, disturbance, injury or noisiness to the
residents wi thin the surrounding area of his food establishment ;
and

(d) operate other activit ies in his food establishment other than the
food preparation activity as specified in his licence.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Medical examination and basic course in food preparation
23. (1) Any person who is involved in food preparation in any food establishment
shall—

(a) undergo a medical examination as the Perbadanan may direct;

(b) be inoculated against any infectious diseases; and

(c) attend a basic course for food preparation  recognized by the
Ministry of Health Malaysia.

(2) The medical examination and inoculation against any infectious disease s
shall be carried out by a medical or health officer registered under the Medical Act 1971
[Act 50].

(3) A licensee shall—

(a) comply with the requirement s of paragraph (1) if the licensee
himself is involved in food preparation  in any food establishment;
and

(b) ensure his employees involved in food preparation comply with
the requirements of paragraph (1).

(4) Any licensee who fails to comply with paragraph (3) commits an offence.

(5) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), any person who is involved in food
preparation in any food establishment  may be directed by the Perbadanan at any time
to—

(a) undergo a medical examination;

(b) be inoculated against any infectious diseases; and

(c) attend a basic course relating to food preparation.

(6) Any person who fails to comply with paragraph (5) commits an offence.

Person prohibited from preparing food
24. (1) Any person who is suffering or carrying any infectious disease shall not be
involved in food preparation in any food establishment.

(2) Any person who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Sanitary requirements
25. (1) A licensee of any food establishment shall—

(a) cause and ensure all refuse to be collected and packed in to plastic
bags and placed in covered receptacles provided for that purpose,
and shall cause all such receptacles to be emptied and cleaned as
frequently as may  be ne cessary to keep the food establishment
clean and tidy at all times;

(b) cause the floors and the walls of the food establishment to be
maintained and kept in a clean condition at all times;

(c) take necessary measures to keep the food establishment free from
rodent, fly, insect or vermin infestations;

(d) ensure the food and drink s displayed for sale shall be in a clean
condition and covered with a food cover at all times;

(e) use only containers or packing materials as determined or
permitted by the Perbadanan to pack food for sale;

(f) not pack food for customers with unclean paper or paper with
writing on it or printed paper or with material which may
contaminate the food; and

(g) maintain or cause to be maintain ed every part of the food
establishment, including its fittings or fixtures, so as to be in a state
of cleanliness and in good condition at all times.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Maintenance of food establishment
26. (1) A licensee shall maintain his  food establishment and the  equipment used
in his food establishment so as to be in a state of cleanliness and in good working order
at all times.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

(3) A licensee shall paint or repaint his food establishment or any part of it at
any time as may be directed by the Perbadanan.

Classification of food establishment
27. (1) The Perbadanan may, at any  time, assess and classify any food
establishment according to Grade A, B or C based on the sanitation of t he premises and
hygiene in respect of food, food handlers and practices of food handlings:

Provided that nothing in this by -law shall be construed so as to preclude any
licensee from the liability of prosecution.

(2) Upon determination of assessment and classification, the Perbadanan
shall issue to the licensee a category card in such form as determined by the
Perbadanan showing the grade the food establishment is classified.

(3) The Perbadanan may, at any time, revise any grade in any category card in
which case a new category card shall be issued to the licensee.

(4) The licensee shall display the catego ry card in a conspicuous place i n the
food establishment.

(5) No licensee shall remove, deface or damage, or cause or allow to be
removed, defaced or damaged a category card.

(6) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (4) or (5) commits an offence.

Closure of insanitary food establishment
28. (1) The Perbadanan may in writing order the closure forthwith of any food
establishment if the Perbadanan  is of the opinio n that such food establishment is
suspected of being a source of infection or is likely to become a source of infection and
the licensee who fails to comply with such order commits an offence.

(2) The Perbadanan may take any  necessary steps to close the f ood
establishment if the licensee fails to comply with the order issued under paragraph (1).

(3) Any licensee who continues to operate a food establishment which is
closed under this by-law commits an offence.

(4) The Perbadanan may, after due inquiry , allow the food establishment to
be reopened if the Perbadanan  is satisfied that the source of infection has been
eliminated.

(5) The licensee for the food establishment which is closed under this by-law
shall not be entitled to claim any compensation from the Perbadanan.

Animals are prohibited
29. (1) No licensee shall keep any animal or knowingly permit any animal to
enter his food establishment.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the li censee may keep fish in an
aquarium in his food establishment for the purpose of preparation of food  or for display
and shall maintain the aquarium in a good and clean condition.

Place for preparation of food
30.  (1) All food shall be prepared in a desig nated place for food preparation
within the area of a food establishment.

(2) A licensee shall , at all times,  ensure the place for preparation of  food is
always clean.

(3) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) or (2) commits an offence.

Sinks and sanitary fittings
31. (1) A licensee shall provide sufficient sinks, sanitary fittings and accessories
for the purpose of food preparation and to provide separate washing facilities for
washing appliances and equipment used.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Water supply
32. (1) A licensee shall not use any water other than water from the public water
supply and shall not use tap water from any toilet for food preparation.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Storage
33. (1) A store shall be provided for the storage of foodstuffs, utensils, equipment
and crockery and such store  shall not be used for any other purposes and shall be
maintained to be in a good and clean condition at all times.

(2) Cupboards, cabinets, racks or shelves used for storage shall be maintained
to be in a clean condition at all times.

(3) All foodstuffs, utensils, equipment and crockery shall be stored or placed
at least 20 centimetres above the floor level.

(4) Any licensee who contravenes this by-law commits an offence.

Provision of restrooms and lockers
34. (1) The Perbadanan may, if it thinks necessary, require a licensee to provide
restrooms and a number of lockers for male and female workers separately.

(2) Any licensee who fails to comply with paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Crowded space is prohibited
35. (1) A licensee shall ensure that his food establishment is not crowded with
any furniture, things or other goods related to his food preparation activities which may
affect the safety, health or in a situation that may cause nuisance to any person within
the food establishment.

(2) If in the opinion of the Perbadanan any food establishment is in a
crowded situation, the Perbadanan may by notice in writing direct the licensee within
the period specified in the notice to rearrange the furniture, things or goods within the
food establishment until the Perbadanan is satisfied that the food establishment is no
longer in a crowded situation.

(3) Any licensee who fails to comply with the notice issued under
paragraph (2) commits an offence.

(4) Notwithstanding paragraph (3), any licensee who fails to comply with
paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Nuisance
36. (1) A licensee shall not, during the operation of a food establishment, create
or cause or allow any nuisance to occur.

(2) Any licensee who contravenes paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Operating hours for food establishment
37. (1) The Perbadanan may direct a food establishment to be operated within
the period and time specified by the Perbadanan and the licensee shall comply with
such direction.

(2) The Perbadanan may consider an application from the licensee to extend
the period and time specified by the Perbadanan under paragraph (1) upon receiving an
application in writing from the licensee.

(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (2), any licensee who contravene s
paragraph (1) commits an offence.

Power to require information
38. (1) For the purpose  of tracing the source and preventing the spread of any
infection, the Perbadanan may require a licensee of a food establishment to furnish any

information or produce for inspection any document, book or record pertaining to any
person employed by him.

(2) Any licensee who refuses to give any information or produce any
document, book or record commits an offence.

Power to enter premise for inspection purpose
39. The Perbadanan may—

(a) enter and inspect any food establishment  or a building or any part of a
building which the Perbadanan suspects with reasonable cause is being
used to operate a food establishment for which a licence is required under
these By-laws; or

(b) request from a licensee any information regarding the management of the
food establishment  and the licensee or his employee shall provide any
information required from him.

Exemption
40. The Perbadanan may, conditionally or unconditionally, exempt any licensee from
any provision of these By-laws.

Penalty
41. Any person who contravenes any provis ion of these By -laws commits an offence
and shall, upon conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding two thousand ringgit or to
imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year or to both , and in the case of a
continuing offence , to a fine not exceeding two  hundred ringg it for each day during
which the offence is continued after conviction.

Revocation and transitional provisions
42. (1) The Labuan Municipal Council (Food and Eating Premises)  By-Laws 1968
[G.N.L. 9 of 1968] is revoked.

(2) Any licence issued or approval granted under the revoked By -laws before
the coming into operation of these By -laws shall continue in full force until the licence
expires, is amended, suspended or cancelled, or the approval expires or revoked under
the revoked By-laws, for which purpose only the revoked By-laws shall continue to be in
full force and effect.

(3) Any proceedings pending or commenced under the revoked By -laws
before the coming into operation of these By -laws shall be continued and concluded
under the revoked By-laws as if these By-laws has not been made.
